meta.rule: For target year Y, use only agricultural years before Y at that site (all complete years from 2001 to Y-1). For each delay in {0,5,...,30} days after the rain-onset rule, collect the rotation water index (first emulator output) of those past years; summarise it with the priority (typical = median, cautious = 20th percentile); choose the delay with the highest summary, ties to the delay closest to 0. Baseline = delay 0. Oracle = the feasible delay with the best simulator water index in year Y itself.

soils.site: SoilGrids soil of the pilot (scripts/emulator/points.json); emulators receive the pilot nearestTexture

meta.toleranceNote: The tolerance 0.001 (water index and maize relYield) is part of the fixed design. Implementer conventions, not fixed by the design: the same 0.001 applied to AquaCrop yields in t/ha; the tie epsilon 1e-12 of chooseOffset; the hindsight offsets; AquaCrop gain % = mean gain / mean baseline yield (ratio of means). Simulator-only win = simulator maize gain > 0 and AquaCrop gain <= 0, exact, no tolerance (so a simulator gain of 0.001 counts).

policies.simulator: the simulator (runSequence) on the past years
policies.mlp: web/data/emulator_mlp.json (funnel network 27-64-32-16-3, backpropagation) via mlpPredict; waterIndex clamped to [0,1] as the page does
policies.elmBrowser: ELM without backpropagation, trainELM(web/data/emulator_train_subset.json, browserElmRecommendation), as web/js/emulatorPage.js trains it; waterIndex clamped to [0,1]

emulators.trainedOn: test = year 2019-2024 OR pointId heldOut (asuncionmita, gualan, rabinal, sanarate); train = rest
emulators.note: Both emulators were trained on agricultural years before 2019 of 16 of the 20 municipalities (held out: gualan, sanarate, asuncionmita, rabinal); the 3 pilots are in the training set; the funnel network used 2017-2018 (valYears) for validation and not for fitting; the target years 2019-2024 were never used to train either emulator.

meta.truth: simulator with the case soil (site soil object for site cases); relYield of the maize counts 0 if its cycle is incomplete; overlap = days from the later sowing to the earlier harvest of maize and beans

aquacrop.convention: season 1 Apr Y .. 31 Mar Y+1; initial water at wilting point (dry) or field capacity (fc) on 1 Apr; default crop parameters
aquacrop.scope: site-soil cases only, maize only, one season per case, same thetaFC/thetaWP as the simulator, dry start; sowing date from resolveMainSowIdx

runtime.policyEvaluationNote: truth tables for 12 site-soil combinations x 11 delays plus 3 policies x 2 priorities x 72 cases (each simulator decision re-runs the simulator on the past years)

posthocAquacrop.label: post-hoc analysis, outside the fixed design (analisis posterior, no forma parte del diseño fijado); the tables in `aggregates` are unchanged
